name: roll-call
description: A status roll-up of your side sessions (/rollcall): each crab holds a sign saying where its session stands, with a 'needs you' lane for sessions waiting on your answer, your OK or your checkbox.

summarizer.title: Who writes each line
summarizer.description: haiku: a short Claude Haiku call per changed session. local: the local-llm MCP server on your Ollama box (free, stays on the LAN; slower). none: read the last message only.

scope.title: Which sessions
scope.description: linked: this session's family (what /crew shows). open: every open session, newest first.

limit.title: At most this many sessions
limit.description: Reads at most this many sessions per roll call (1-60), newest first.
